'''Tovarskl''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and a [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] world of the [[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]].

==History==
During the [[Huk War]], [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] led his [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] elites and forces as far as Tovarskl in their bloody campaign of conquest, before the [[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]] beseeched the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for help and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived to halt the conflict.

As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] raged, after being rebuilt as a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] and becoming the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]], Grievous commanded his new legions of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] back to Tovarskl where he [[Battle of Tovarskl|finished]] what he had started before, annihilating the Yam'rii population. Grievous also killed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Puroth]] and [[Nystammall]] on the fire-grass plains of Tovarskl, taking their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] as trophies.

In [[44 ABY]], Tovarskl was the site of a battle as Moffs of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] fought over territory amid [[Natasi Daala]]'s scheming against [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]].<ref name="FOTJ9">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed that, contrary to the [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]] article in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', Tovarskl is in a separate system than Kalee, like represented on the [[Pentastar Alignment]] map.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30387023|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2009-08-28|time=11:05 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180225165344/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-109}}</ref>
